rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / SPECIAL REVENUE FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR ENDING 6/30/12`, PDF pages 66-70 of the FY2012 annual town report (4118-fy-2012-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folios 63-67 -- the Town Accountant's special revenue schedule, five pages read as ONE table. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words on all 116 pages, tested per page -- so the schedule was read off the pages' own 518 dpi bitmaps. NO recognition was used and the existing recognition extract was NOT a starting point: it holds 137 rows for these five pages, five of which are the PRINTED PAGE NUMBERS 63, 64, 65, 66 and 67 read as money, and its `v` fields are ORDINALS (the first column of a row that held a figure) rather than columns, so a fund with no FORWARD has its RECEIPTS sitting under `v1`. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4), is `PROGRAM NAME` | `FORWARD 7/1/2011` | `TOTAL RECEIPTS` | `TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS` | `BALANCE FWD 7/1/2012`, repeated verbatim at the top of all five pages, with the section headings `GENERAL GOVERNMENT`, `SCHOOL DEPARTMENT`, `PUBLIC SAFETY`, `PARKS & RECREATION`, `HIGHWAY DEPT.`, `COUNCIL ON AGING`, `LIBRARY`, `CEMETERIES` and `UNCLASSIFIED` printed between the funds. WHAT PROVES IT: the 127 fund rows foot to the GRAND TOTAL printed at the foot of page 70 in ALL FOUR columns, EXACTLY, no tolerance declared -- 2,766,954.67 forward, 5,976,644.29 receipts, 6,680,977.17 disbursements and 2,062,621.79 carried forward. AND EVERY ROW PROVES ITSELF: forward + receipts - disbursements = balance holds for 127 of 127 rows to the cent, computed from the figures in this file at the time they were read. That identity is NOT declared as a `check` row because this verifier's identity syntax is either all-addition or first-minus-rest and cannot express an addition and a subtraction together; the disbursements are recorded with the sign the page prints rather than negated to fit it. Anyone can recompute it from these rows. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: a special revenue fund is money the town holds OUTSIDE the general fund appropriation, so nothing here is part of the appropriations schedule on pp.60-65 and the two must not be added. The schedule shows dollars moving, not what they bought, and it does not say which grant or fee paid for which post (CLAUDE.md rule 11).
